description: fetch_mta_sts_policy_body enforces redirect::Policy::none() and double-checks the redirect status code explicitly. The comment explains why (attacker redirect to controlled server). A future contributor might think 'just follow redirects for robustness' — this must not change. RFC 8461 §3.3 is unambiguous: the policy MUST be fetched without following redirects. The defence-in-depth (reqwest policy + explicit status check) is correct.
title: No-redirect policy in fetch_url is well-defended and mandatory
